content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I need to print a check label using controller parameters directly from the controller without a computer. What is the easiest way to connect a printer to the controller and use it? I considered using a modem module or an interface module, but it's not clear or simple how to proceed. I'm also facing challenges with printer formatting. If I can access the controller parameters, I need a way to format them for printing. Any suggestions are welcome. Is it possible to export controller parameters? Is there any hardware or printer available that can arrange the data layout before printing? Thanks.
Is there really no solution to this issue?

Dear [user_name], It seems that direct printing from a [product_name] device to a printer is currently not supported. You could try printing via a panel connected to your [product_name] device. Consider checking with the vendor on the device described here: [url] Vendor website: [url] Best Regards.
Thank you for the idea. I'm exploring your suggestion. Are there any other solutions from other users?

Dear [user_name], I found this [document] (search for "printer"). [url] From what I gather, you may be able to generate your reports and print them to a connected printer through the USB or serial port of the panel. Please confirm with vendor support for details. Best Regards.

Dear [user_name], I received confirmation from the vendor that direct printing from the T4A panel to the printer is possible (text only, without graphics). I hope this information is helpful. Verify with the supplier about compatible printer types. Best Regards.
Thank you very much for your assistance, [user_name]. I attempted to use Codesys for programming the T4A panel, but it's beyond my capabilities. Is there any alternative way to program the T4A panel?
Dear [user_name], You should use iX Developer Software to program the HMI panel. [url] You can try the 30-day demo for free. Running it on a virtual machine might also be an option. Best Regards.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is trying to print check labels using controller parameters directly from the device, without involving a computer. The main challenge is that direct printing is not supported, as well as issues with exporting parameters and printer formatting. Workarounds include using external HMI panels with printing support, but these solutions can be complex for users who are not comfortable with required programming or software.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects a simple way to export controller parameters for printing, ideally with minimal setup and built-in support for formatting. They also hope for clear documentation or compatible hardware to make the process easier.
